template.name: Butterfly Pattern
template.entry_long: close > open and low <= donchian_low_prev(low,{p0}) and close > sma(close,{p1})
template.notes: No butterfly lookback, harmonic X/A/B/C/D ratios, or target values are supplied. A bullish reversal at a prior three-bar low with an SMA(20) filter is a bounded proxy; harmonic validation, three staged targets, break-even/trailing logic, and the short side are unsupported.
